newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China EB Tech not aware of any HKTel negotiations.
newsitem.headline: China EB Tech not aware of any HKTel negotiations.

text.p: China Everbright Technology Ltd said on Wednesday it was not aware of any negotiations or agreement relating to a possible acquisition by the company of shares in Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd.

CITIC Pacific Ltd said last Friday it had agreed in principle to sell its 7.74 percent stake in Hongkong Telecom to a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Everbright Holdings Co Ltd, the parent of China Everbright Technology.
Trading in the shares of China Everbright Technology was suspended on Tuesday, prompting speculation that the Hong Kong Telecom stake would be injected into China Everbright Technology.
China Everbright Technology said trading in its shares was due to resume on Wednesday. The stock jumped HK$0.33 last Friday and HK$0.64 on Monday to last trade at HK$1.89.
It said it had net profit of HK$74.6 million in the six months to September 30, 1996, and its net asset value was about HK$0.11 per share.
China Everbright Holdings has two other listed subsidiaries: China Everbright International Ltd and China Everbright-IHD Pacific Ltd.
